sources.label: Wallapop España
sources.caveat: Wallapop España is read through Wallapop's unofficial web API: asking prices from private sellers near one city, best-effort. Wallapop's terms of use require its express authorization to use it: https://about.wallapop.com/condiciones-de-uso/
